≡ ~N ∨ (N ⊃ ~O) (Implication equivalence: A ⊃ B ≡ ~A ∨ B)
≡ ~N ∨ (~N ∨ ~O) (Implication equivalence again)

- C) O ∨ Q: Requires N ⊃ ~O first, then Modus Ponens with premise (1). This would be at least two steps (HS + equivalence + MP).
- D) ~P: Cannot be derived in one step.

Therefore, N ⊃ ~O is the most plausible immediate consequence among the choices.
